verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB presents itself as fully managed ClickHouse hosting. Its one route toward self-hosting is a BYOC mode in which 'your data never leaves your cloud or your hardware,' so the product can run in customer-controlled infrastructure, though nothing shows it is self-operable. The docs on moving a self-managed ClickHouse deployment describe migrating into ObsessionDB, not self-hosting it, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a downloadable or open-source distribution, self-managed install/operations docs, clarity on whether BYOC is customer-operated or vendor-operated, and independent corroboration.
